zh.title: 亞馬遜塗裝波音767在邁阿密衝出跑道造成5死
zh.summary: 亞馬遜塗裝波音767在邁阿密衝出跑道，造成五人死亡多人受傷。
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，一架掛有 Amazon Prime Air 品牌塗裝的波音767-300F飛機於2026年9月6日星期日在邁阿密國際機場（Miami International Airport）發生衝出跑道事故。該起跑道偏離事件造成五人死亡，另有其他人員受傷。
報導指出，這起偏離跑道的事件是在該架飛機降落觸地後不久發生的。目前有關該起事故的確切發生原因、機上總人數以及其餘受傷人員的詳細傷勢，仍有待調查釐清。

en.title: Amazon Prime Air-Branded Boeing 767 Overruns Runway in Miami Leaving 5 Dead
en.summary: Amazon Prime Air-branded Boeing 767 overruns runway in Miami; five dead and others injured
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying, an Amazon Prime Air-branded Boeing 767-300F aircraft went off a runway at Miami International Airport. The safety occurrence took place on Sunday, September 6, 2026, shortly after the aircraft completed its touchdown on the runway.

The runway excursion resulted in five deaths, and other individuals sustained injuries during the accident. At the time of reporting, additional details concerning the exact circumstances of the landing excursion, the total number of people on board the flight, and the medical condition of those who were injured have not been released.
